description: The plot illustrates relative change (in percent) across grouped transformer layer ranges for several KV-cache compression settings, with a dashed baseline reference. The x-axis is categorical with five tick labels—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%, spanning approximately from +5% at the top to −25% at the bottom; a gray dashed horizontal line marks the 0% baseline (“Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”). Four solid lines are shown: (1) a light yellow line with circular markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) that stays near 0%, starting around 0% at Layer1-4, remaining near 0% at Layer5-12, dipping to about −2% at Layer13-20, returning to about 0% at Layer21-28, and ending slightly above 0% (around +0.5%) at Layer29-32; (2) a red line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) that starts at about 0% at Layer1-4, moves to roughly −1% at Layer5-12, reaches about −4.5% at Layer13-20, rises to around −1.5% at Layer21-28, and ends near 0% at Layer29-32; (3) a light blue line with circular markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) that begins near −2% at Layer1-4, is around −2.5% at Layer5-12, drops to roughly −13% at Layer13-20, rises to about −2.5% at Layer21-28, and ends near −1.5% at Layer29-32; and (4) a dark blue line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) that starts around −3% at Layer1-4, is near −4.5% at Layer5-12, reaches its lowest point around −25% at Layer13-20, increases to about −5.5% at Layer21-28, and ends around −3.5% at Layer29-32.
